CONTROL LOGIC DESIGN NOTE
Two-Tank Fill/Transfer/Drain Controller
Document | CDS-02
Revision | B
Date | 20 Feb 2026
Status | Released after design review DR-02
Note | CR-004 updates numeric parameters but not state semantics
1. Objective
This note defines the controller state semantics and resolves command-priority questions raised against URS-001 Rev A. It does not replace the mechanical model or supplier data. Numeric setpoints and delays shall follow the latest approved parameter/change records.
2. State Definitions
State | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3) | Definition / Exit Condition
IDLE | 0,0,0 | All valves closed. A START edge begins FILL_T1. A SHUT command while already empty has no useful hydraulic effect and may be treated as completed shutdown.
FILL_T1 | 1,0,0 | Command XV-101 open. XV-102 and XV-103 closed. Transition when LT-101 >= T1_High.
WAIT_AFTER_FILL | 0,0,0 | All valves closed. Hold for the configured post-fill wait. STOP freezes remaining time.
TRANSFER_T1_T2 | 0,1,0 | Command XV-102 open. V1 and V3 closed. Transition when LT-101 <= T1_Low.
WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | 0,0,0 | All valves closed. Hold for configured post-transfer wait. STOP freezes remaining time.
DRAIN_T2 | 0,0,1 | Command XV-103 open. V1 and V2 closed. Transition when LT-102 <= T2_Low.
WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | 0,0,0 | All valves closed. Hold for inter-cycle wait, then return to FILL_T1 automatically.
PAUSED | 0,0,0 | All valves closed. Preserve the interrupted sequence state and, if applicable, its remaining timer. START resumes the stored state.
SHUTDOWN | 0,1,1 | V1 closed; V2 and V3 commanded open together. Remain in SHUTDOWN until both tanks are at or below their low-level limits, then close all valves and go to IDLE.
3. Command Priority and Edge Semantics
SHUT has the highest command priority. A valid SHUT edge immediately abandons any stored resume context and enters SHUTDOWN.
STOP has the next priority. STOP is accepted from any normal running or wait state and places the controller in PAUSED with all valve outputs false.
START has the lowest priority. START from IDLE begins FILL_T1; START from PAUSED restores the interrupted state. START while already running is ignored.
Commands received while SHUTDOWN is active do not interrupt the shutdown sequence. A new START is required after shutdown has completed and the controller has returned to IDLE.
4. Timer Resume Rule
When STOP occurs in WAIT_AFTER_FILL, WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER or WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN, the remaining delay shall be retained. START shall resume with that remaining delay. Reinitializing the whole delay on resume was rejected in DR-02 because it makes operator stop duration affect process timing.
5. Interlocks and Constraints
V1 and V2 shall never be open simultaneously.
V2 and V3 shall not be open simultaneously during normal automatic operation.
The V2/V3 simultaneous-open restriction is explicitly waived in SHUTDOWN.
All valves are de-energize-to-close. On controller power loss, output commands shall be false.
Level threshold comparisons shall include equality (>= high, <= low).
6. State Transition Table
From | Trigger / Guard | To | Actions | Comment
IDLE | START edge | FILL_T1 | V1=1 | new cycle
FILL_T1 | LT-101 >= T1_High | WAIT_AFTER_FILL | V1=0; start timer | 
WAIT_AFTER_FILL | timer expired | TRANSFER_T1_T2 | V2=1 | 
TRANSFER_T1_T2 | LT-101 <= T1_Low | WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | V2=0; start timer | 
WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | timer expired | DRAIN_T2 | V3=1 | 
DRAIN_T2 | LT-102 <= T2_Low | WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | V3=0; start timer | 
WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | timer expired | FILL_T1 | V1=1 | automatic repeat
normal/wait | STOP edge | PAUSED | all valves 0 | store state + remaining wait
PAUSED | START edge | stored state | restore state outputs | resume
any non-shutdown | SHUT edge | SHUTDOWN | V1=0,V2=1,V3=1 | clear resume context
SHUTDOWN | LT-101 <= T1_Low AND LT-102 <= T2_Low | IDLE | V2=0,V3=0 | shutdown complete
7. Naming Cross-Reference
Legacy simulation code uses states FILL, HOLD1, TRANSFER, HOLD2, DRAIN and HOLD3. These map to FILL_T1, WAIT_AFTER_FILL, TRANSFER_T1_T2, WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER, DRAIN_T2 and WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN respectively. The old code has no explicit PAUSED state object and handles STOP with a Boolean latch.
8. Open Items at Release
Controls tuning requested a small increase in T1 high limit above the 0.78 m URS baseline. Formal approval was pending when Rev B of this note was issued.
Post-transfer and inter-cycle delays were still under customer review at document release. Use a later approved change request if available.
